result.instructions: Tools for Shotstack, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Render a 15-second vertical promo video from this timeline and tell me when it is done."; "List our saved Shotstack templates and render the one called 'weekly recap' with these merge fields."; "How long is this video file, and what size and frame rate does it have?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shotstack data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shotstack_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shotstack_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shotstack_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shotstack_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shotstack_render_video
tools.title: Render a video
tools.description: Submit a timeline and output to render a video. Returns a render id: poll shotstack_get_render until status is done or failed. Production renders use credits; sandbox renders are free and watermarked. Edit API: POST /render.

timeline.description: Shotstack timeline object: `tracks` (required, each with `clips`), plus optional `background`, `soundtrack`, `fonts`, `cache`.

output.description: Shotstack output object: `format` (required, for example mp4), plus `resolution`, `aspectRatio`, `fps`, `size`, `quality`, `destinations`.

merge.description: Merge fields: each `{{ find }}` placeholder in the timeline is replaced by `replace`.

tools.name: shotstack_get_render
tools.title: Get a render
tools.description: Get a render's status (queued, fetching, rendering, saving, done or failed) and, when done, its output url. Set data or merged to also return the edit JSON. Edit API: GET /render/{id}.

data.description: Also return the edit JSON that produced the render.

merged.description: Return the edit JSON with merge fields applied (needs data).

tools.name: shotstack_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List the saved Shotstack templates in this environment, with their ids and names. Good first call before shotstack_render_template. Edit API: GET /templates.

tools.name: shotstack_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one saved template by id, including its timeline and output. Edit API: GET /templates/{id}.

template_id.description: The template id (from shotstack_list_templates or shotstack_create_template).

tools.name: shotstack_create_template
tools.title: Create a template
tools.description: Save a timeline and output as a named template, so it can be rendered later with merge fields. Creates a new template; it does not render. Edit API: POST /templates.

timeline.description: Shotstack timeline object: `tracks` (required, each with `clips`), plus optional `background`, `soundtrack`, `fonts`, `cache`.

output.description: Shotstack output object: `format` (required, for example mp4), plus `resolution`, `aspectRatio`, `fps`, `size`, `quality`, `destinations`.

merge.description: Merge fields: each `{{ find }}` placeholder in the timeline is replaced by `replace`.

tools.name: shotstack_update_template
tools.title: Update a template
tools.description: Replace the name, timeline and output of a saved template. The whole template is replaced, so send the full timeline and output. Edit API: PUT /templates/{id}.

template_id.description: The template id (from shotstack_list_templates or shotstack_create_template).

timeline.description: Shotstack timeline object: `tracks` (required, each with `clips`), plus optional `background`, `soundtrack`, `fonts`, `cache`.

output.description: Shotstack output object: `format` (required, for example mp4), plus `resolution`, `aspectRatio`, `fps`, `size`, `quality`, `destinations`.

merge.description: Merge fields: each `{{ find }}` placeholder in the timeline is replaced by `replace`.

tools.name: shotstack_delete_template
tools.title: Delete a template
tools.description: Delete a saved template by id. The template cannot be recovered afterwards. Renders already made are not affected. Edit API: DELETE /templates/{id}.

template_id.description: The template id (from shotstack_list_templates or shotstack_create_template).

tools.name: shotstack_render_template
tools.title: Render a template
tools.description: Render a saved template, with optional merge fields for this video. Returns a render id: poll shotstack_get_render. Production renders use credits. Edit API: POST /templates/render.

template_id.description: The template id (from shotstack_list_templates or shotstack_create_template).

merge.description: Merge fields: each `{{ find }}` placeholder in the timeline is replaced by `replace`.

tools.name: shotstack_probe_media
tools.title: Inspect a media file
tools.description: Inspect a public media file (video, audio or image) by url: duration, dimensions, codecs and frame rate. Use it before you put footage in a timeline. Edit API: GET /probe/{url}.

media_url.description: Public https url of the media file.

tools.name: shotstack_list_models
tools.title: List AI models
tools.description: List the AI generation models (video, image, voice and music) with their options. Listing costs nothing. Edit API: GET /models.

tools.name: shotstack_get_model
tools.title: Get an AI model
tools.description: Get one AI generation model by id, with its options and pricing basis. Edit API: GET /models/{id}.

tools.name: shotstack_quote_generation
tools.title: Quote an AI generation
tools.description: Price an AI-generated asset before you generate it. Quoting does not generate or charge the asset. Edit API: POST /generate/quote.

asset.description: Asset to price: `type` (video, image, audio, ...), plus `prompt`, `model` and `options`.

length.description: Length in seconds, for video and audio assets.
